review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — pacerTransitions and scorePaced are exported with per-transition type, phase, matches, d, points and missed/double. paced.test.ts covers missed, double, signs at peaks and troughs, e = 0.05, 0.95 and 3, the four skill bands from skillBandK, and SD_time of 2 s and 5 s.
- A2: met — Scores (total via combineTransitionScores), onTargetPct, direction in SD, s and % of max, histograms plus missed/double, and counts are returned. The hand-worked four-transition example checks each one, and the values agree with a manual recomputation.
- A3: met — paced-tier-a.ts holds literal inputs, derivations and expectations with no comments. onTime, early at Beginner/Intermediate/Expert, halfDepth, deep and offset match the card values, and all early timing values land in bin [-0.5, -0.25).
- A4: met — The shortCycle fixture matches the card's per-peak and per-trough timing points, 49/9, 86/17, 9.0, 134/17, Total 6.8, 6 doubles, 0 missed and 29/35. End-to-end Tier A runs onTime and early.
- A5: met — One shared seed and noise setting is stored as data, and all six profile ranges are asserted in paced-golden.test.ts. Whether they pass rests on the test run.
- A6: met — Appendix numbers are read from config. Three new FIXED_CONSTANTS keys are added only, with paced-config.test.ts asserting them, and index.ts re-exports paced. Lint, typecheck and test results come from the deterministic checks.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Inclusive ±1 SD window compares computed floats exactly `src/lib/analysis/paced.ts:145` — Compare against window plus a tiny epsilon (e.g. 1e-9 * sdTime), or compute pacer.t from integer arithmetic, and add a test for a non-integer half cycle.
- Breath length is assumed to be 2 × halfCycleS `src/lib/analysis/paced.ts:116`

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Inclusive ±1 SD window compares computed floats exactly
suggestions.detail: pacer.t is computed as k * halfCycleS and the window as 1 * sdTime. For half cycles that are not exact binary fractions, either value can be off by one ulp, so a user transition exactly 1 SD away can be classed as single or missed depending on rounding. That decides between a scored match and a missed transition worth 1 point. The current fixtures use integer half cycles, which avoids this.
suggestions.repro: Not reachable with the 5-5 / 2-2 fixtures. A hypothetical case: halfCycleS = 2.2, so pacer t = 3 * 2.2 = 6.6000000000000005, and a user peak at 6.6 + 2.2 sits on the window edge.
suggestions.fix: Compare against window plus a tiny epsilon (e.g. 1e-9 * sdTime), or compute pacer.t from integer arithmetic, and add a test for a non-integer half cycle.

suggestions.title: Breath length is assumed to be 2 × halfCycleS
suggestions.detail: SD_time is timingSdBreathFraction * 2 * halfCycleS, and pacer transitions alternate at a fixed halfCycleS. That fits the card's symmetric pacers (2-2, 5-5). An asymmetric pacer (for example 4-6) cannot be expressed through this API. Out of scope for this card; noted for later batches.

acceptance.note: pacerTransitions and scorePaced are exported with per-transition type, phase, matches, d, points and missed/double. paced.test.ts covers missed, double, signs at peaks and troughs, e = 0.05, 0.95 and 3, the four skill bands from skillBandK, and SD_time of 2 s and 5 s.

Scores (total via combineTransitionScores), onTargetPct, direction in SD, s and % of max, histograms plus missed/double, and counts are returned. The hand-worked four-transition example checks each one, and the values agree with a manual recomputation.

paced-tier-a.ts holds literal inputs, derivations and expectations with no comments. onTime, early at Beginner/Intermediate/Expert, halfDepth, deep and offset match the card values, and all early timing values land in bin [-0.5, -0.25).
The shortCycle fixture matches the card's per-peak and per-trough timing points, 49/9, 86/17, 9.0, 134/17, Total 6.8, 6 doubles, 0 missed and 29/35. End-to-end Tier A runs onTime and early.
One shared seed and noise setting is stored as data, and all six profile ranges are asserted in paced-golden.test.ts. Whether they pass rests on the test run.

Appendix numbers are read from config. Three new FIXED_CONSTANTS keys are added only, with paced-config.test.ts asserting them, and index.ts re-exports paced. Lint, typecheck and test results come from the deterministic checks.
